summary: Iteration 3 retest via the public URL. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests pass (test_iter3_limits_approve.py). (1) Login lockout: 5 wrong PINs from one IP are rejected and the 6th returns 429 with Retry-After. This works with a spoofed XFF and with no header, and another IP can still log in. (2) The registration limit returns 429 on the 11th request in an hour per IP, and a different IP still gets 201. (3) Approve creates the student with the right bono, money, phone and health data. A second approve returns 404 with no duplicate. Five concurrent approves give exactly one 200 and one student. (4) Attendance regression works (counter decrements, duplicate returns 409). NEW SECURITY ISSUE: _client_key trusts the first X-Forwarded-For entry, and the client controls it. Seven wrong PINs, each with a different XFF, all returned 401 and none was ever locked. A real IP that was already locked got 200 by adding 'X-Forwarded-For: 8.8.8.8'. Both the brute-force lockout and the registration spam limit can therefore be bypassed with one header. Frontend (375x667): the flow from registration form to success works. Wrong PIN shows an error, and the correct PIN opens Alumnos. Pending banner leads to /solicitudes. Approve/reject buttons measure 151x44 and 311x44. A stale approve shows 'Solicitud no encontrada o ya gestionada' and the card disappears after refresh. A mocked GET 500 shows requests-load-error with requests-retry-btn (44px high), and retry brings the list back. Approve 10 removes the card. Attendance shows a toast on #1A642B with white text (readable), and the button changes to 'Asistió'. The register button now has maxWidth 150. NEW UI BUG: opening /solicitudes directly (reload or deep link) and tapping requests-back-btn shows the dev error "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled" and the user stays stuck on the screen. No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected.

critical.issue: Spoofable client IP. _client_key (server.py:86-91) uses X-Forwarded-For.split(',')[0], and the client supplies that value. The ingress appends to the header instead of overwriting it. Reproduction: 7 wrong PINs with XFF 10.9.N.1 all returned 401 and none locked. A locked real IP plus 'X-Forwarded-For: 8.8.8.8' and the correct PIN returned 200. An attacker can brute-force the 6-digit PIN without limit and spam registrations. Fix: use the right-most XFF entry that was not added by our own proxies (the entry the ingress appended, e.g. split(',')[-1], after checking how many hops the ingress adds), and/or add a global failure counter (e.g. 20 failures per 15 min across all IPs) as a backstop.

minor.issue: They are in-memory, so they reset on restart and are not shared between workers. Acceptable for one worker.

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() with no history (page reloaded or /solicitudes opened directly) throws "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled" and nothing happens. Reference: /app/frontend/app/solicitudes.tsx:55. Fix: router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/'). Check acceso.tsx and inscripcion.tsx back buttons for the same problem.

issues: Long names are still truncated: the name column is about 137px while the register button takes 150px (e.g. 'TEST_UI Fernández Ló…'). Consider a smaller/icon-only register button or letting the name wrap to 2 lines.
renew-bono / delete-student icon buttons measure 30x32 on web (below 44). hitSlop does not apply on web. Use padding 10 or minWidth/minHeight 44.

action_items: HIGH: Stop trusting the client-controlled first X-Forwarded-For entry in _client_key. Use the proxy-appended (right-most trusted) entry and add a global login failure cap.
MEDIUM: solicitudes.tsx back button should fall back to router.replace('/') when !router.canGoBack(). Apply the same to the other back buttons.
LOW: Make the renew/delete icon buttons at least 44x44. Consider giving long student names more room.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:86-91 _client_key: XFF spoofing bypasses both limiters (verified).
The approve flow is now correct: it checks for pending, inserts the student, then updates only if still pending, and deletes its own student if it lost a race. Verified with 5 concurrent requests.
The toast now uses brandSecondary #1A642B with white text, which is readable.

success_rate.backend: 83% (6/6 tests pass, but the IP spoofing bypass was found)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows pass; deep-link back button bug)

rca_of_issue: XFF: the client's own header value is kept as the first entry and the ingress appends the real IP, so split(',')[0] is attacker-controlled. GO_BACK: Expo Router has no back stack on a cold load of /solicitudes.
